title: CEMENTS & SEALERS
summary: Applied-material code table, part 4: adhesive 3976460 (alternate 3967848) for body bonding at plenum, hinge pillar, door sill, lock pillar and fenders (87a–87j); plastisol sealer at windshield frame/hinge pillar weld joints (122a–122g); and cement-adhesive 3977818 (226a–226c, folding-top compartment lid and roof molding supports).
notes_internal: Chart sheet (no drawing, no callouts): applied-material codes. PART cell = GM part number + description from the left column, repeated on every row of its group (on the page it is printed once per group).
Words hyphenated across line breaks in USAGE are joined (e.g. RE-/TAINER -> RETAINER); multi-line cells joined with a space.
Model box reads 19000 (all models), so models = [].
Sealer-plastisol part number: 6th digit broken in the scan (looks like 9, OCR read 5); written '99851?8'. Upper-right print is faint overall (122a row, SUB-GRP header).
'U/B' in 87d and 'W/S' in 122b/122c print with a faint slash ('U, B', 'W, S'); written with '/'.
87e UPC prints as a faint tick; read as 1.
No 87f or 122f rows; no removal marked for them on this sheet.
Only revision on this sheet is sym 7 (4-24-70); circled 7 sits in the blank lower-left where the removed 3893632 cement / 88a row was. 'was' = 3893632 (removed, no replacement).
